svg.text: HYBRID MULTI-TIER DOCUMENT OCR & TECHNICAL TRANSLATION ENGINE
Fast-Path Vector Parsing with FinOps Dual-AI Dispatcher
hybrid_engine.py | Intelligent Route Orchestration & Formatting Pipeline

g.text: • Direct extraction of native digital text, font hierarchies, headings, and tables.
• Blazing Execution Speed: 0.1s - 0.3s per page (Sub-second office document processing).
• Zero AI Cost ($0.00): Eliminates unnecessary LLM/OCR calls for 80%+ of standard PDF files.
If page text density > threshold: Emit clean Markdown directly -> Translation Engine
If scanned image or zero text detected: Escalate to Tier 2 OCR Dispatcher
• Renders scanned PDF pages to 300 DPI high-resolution image bitmaps.
• Dual Dispatching Paths: User can toggle between FinOps Free Mode & AWS Native Mode.
Technical Translation Engine & Key Tour Manager
• Strict preservation of 100% Markdown structure, code blocks, tables, and LaTeX math.
• Specialized engineering glossary dictionary (Cloud Computing, AWS, DevOps, Networking).
• Key Tour Manager: Round-Robin rotation across multiple API keys with auto-backoff.
• docx_exporter.py: Microsoft Word (.docx) preserving bold, tables, heading hierarchies
• pdf_exporter.py: Print-ready A4 PDF | markdown_exporter.py: Clean GitHub-flavored .md
• Stores: cv.pdf.md, cv.pdf.docx, cv.pdf.pdf with public presigned download URLs
• SSE-S3 AES-256 Server-Side Encryption enabled on all objects
• Updates job status: PROCESSING -> COMPLETED / FAILED
• Sub-10ms read/write latency with zero provisioned capacity overhead
